= Memcached

Cache tiles using memcached.

Name should be "memcached"

Configuration options:

[cols="1,3,1,1,1"]
|===
| Parameter | Description | Type | Required | Default

| keyprefix
| A prefix to use for keys stored in cache. Helps avoid collisions when multiple applications use the same memcached
| string
| No
| None

| ttl
| How long cache entries should persist for in seconds. Cannot be disabled.
| uint32
| No
| 1 day

| datastore
| The ID of a xref:configuration/datastores/memcached.adoc[memcached datastore] to use.
| string
| Yes
| None
|===

Example:

[,yaml]
----
datastores:
  - name: memcached
    id: memcached-0
    host: 127.0.0.1
    port: 11211

cache:
  name: memcached
  datastore: memcached-0
----
